subject.title: fix(message): ignore populated location on text sends

question: Should `normalizeMessageActionRequest` become a supported generic Plugin SDK hook for channel-owned post-authorization normalization, or should the Telegram repair use a narrower existing/Telegram-specific seam?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes the exported Plugin SDK contract and baseline; correctness tests do not decide whether that permanent extension point is the desired API boundary.

options.title: Accept the generic normalization seam
options.body: Approve the exported hook as the supported channel boundary after fresh final-head Telegram proof confirms the intended behavior.

options.title: Use a narrower seam
options.body: Ask for a Telegram-specific or existing-boundary implementation if the generic hook is not a Plugin SDK contract maintainers want to support.

options.title: Pause the API addition
options.body: Keep the PR open without merging until the permanent plugin API direction is decided.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic normalization seam
recommendation.body: Approve the exported hook as the supported channel boundary after fresh final-head Telegram proof confirms the intended behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current producer-boundary redesign and can provide the requested final-head proof, while a repository owner should make the API decision.
